findings.title: Legacy v1 rows never reach the map under any period, including 30d
spec_refs: spec.md:423-436 (legacy marker renders from legacy orders/sales; 30d legacy display remains available)
spec.md:571-577,705-706 (fixture: V1 count=10 legacy badge under default {New,Conf}+30d; excluded only under 7d/Hari ini)
evidence: apps/web/src/lib/geographic-filters.ts computeFilteredCounts(): a v1 row (no orders_by_status/daily_by_status) yields filteredOrders=0 for every period, including 30d.
apps/web/src/app/data-intelligence/page.tsx:196-203 filteredPoints keeps only entries with counts.filteredOrders > 0, with no legacy fallback.
Same file:210-219 outletsWithoutDailyDetail DOES apply the legacy fallback (legacyOnly ? Number(point.orders) > 0 : ...) — the two adjacent memos disagree on legacy handling.
No phase-3 test covers it: page.test.tsx has no v1-row marker test.
findings.impact: Default 30d view omits the V1 legacy marker (fixture expects H=7 + V1=10); legacy outlets are invisible instead of disclosed.
findings.fix_direction: Apply the same legacy fallback in the filteredPoints gate as outletsWithoutDailyDetail already uses (legacyOnly ? Number(point.orders) > 0), or equivalent; add a page-level test with a v1 row asserting marker presence under 30d and exclusion + disclosure under 7d/Hari ini. Record as append-only correction; do not move any done_sha.

findings.title: Filtered counts gate marker presence but marker badges display unfiltered legacy totals
spec_refs: spec.md:256-264 (one marker per outlet shown only when filtered count > 0; marker count is 7 for New4+Conf3)
spec.md:573 (H marker count is exactly 8 under 7d, not the 30-day total of 10)
T9 packet test intent: 'markers reflect the filtered counts'
evidence: page.tsx:231-232 passes the original point objects (visiblePoints) to GeoMap; the computed counts from computeFilteredCounts are discarded at the boundary.

GeoMap.tsx:59 popupHtml and :213 outlet list render point.orders (full-window legacy total), never a filtered count — fixture outlet H would badge 10 instead of 7 under default {New,Conf}+30d, and 10 instead of 8 under 7d.
The drawer side is correct (OutletDrawer recomputes via computeFilteredCounts), so drawer counts and marker badges disagree for the same outlet/filter.
No phase-3 test asserts a rendered marker badge value.
findings.impact: Every filtered view overstates per-outlet counts on markers/popups/list; spec literal counts (7/8/3) are not rendered anywhere on the map surface.
findings.fix_direction: Propagate the filtered count across the page→GeoMap boundary (e.g. pass counts alongside points and render counts.filteredOrders in popup/list), keeping legacyOnly rows on the legacy-orders display; add an integration test asserting badge text equals the filtered literal for default and 7d selections. Record as append-only correction; do not move any done_sha.
